# myJurist — Court Intelligence

> Reliability-first legal-session intelligence workspace. AI-assisted document and transcript analysis with human-reviewed court intelligence for legal teams.

myJurist helps legal teams turn court-session recordings and transcripts into reviewed, evidence-linked claims and reports. Every AI-assisted draft is verified by a human reviewer before it reaches a report, with role-based access for viewers, reviewers, and lawyers.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/auth): Secure sign-in to the myJurist Court Intelligence workspace.
